text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Good morning... Um, thank you very much, 
have a good rest...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A-And so, um... th-this is for you...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I went to the beach. It was... a 
really nice breath of fresh air...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-So, it's kind of a thank-you... I found 
some pretty sea glass, and... I w-wanted 
to, share it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the souvenirs, I could truly feel 
that Cheval Grand had spent a wonderful 
day off.
